rainier.text: WILDFIRE CLOSURES: Sunrise & northern trails. . Due to several active fires on the north side of the park, the following closures are in effect until further notice: Grand Park area & trails, Northern Loop Trail, Wonderland Trail from Carbon River Suspension Bridge to Frozen Lake, & associated backcountry campgrounds. White River & Sunrise Roads have closed for the winter season.

Fryingpan Creek Bridge Replacement Project: Trail Impacts. Summerland Trailhead is closed at Fryingpan Creek Bridge due to construction through 2029. No pedestrians are allowed on White River Road through the closure zone past Fryingpan Creek Bridge. Bicyclists may travel the closed road but must follow all signage & instructions from construction crews.

SR 165 Carbon River/Fairfax Bridge is closed: no access to Carbon River or Mowich Lake.. There is NO public access to Carbon River & Mowich Lake from SR 165.  The bridge is closed to pedestrians, bicycles and vehicles and there is no alternate route.

Ohanapecosh Campground area closed for construction in 2026. . The entire Ohanapecosh Campground area is CLOSED for the duration of the construction project, including all campsites, visitor center, restrooms, picnic area, & Ohanapecosh river access.

paradise.text: Overnight closure of SR 706 on October 23; no access to Nisqually Entrance.. SR706 outside of the park will be fully CLOSED overnight from 9 pm Friday 10/23 until 6 am Saturday 10/24, for road repairs to replace a second failing culvert. The closure will be from Kernahan Road East to the Nisqually Entrance. There will be NO ACCESS to the Nisqually Entrance during the closure. To reach Paradise during the closure plan to enter/exit the park through the Stevens Canyon Entrance via SR123 on the east side of the park.

Winter Season Closures. The following regular winter season road closures are in place: Paradise Valley, Ricksecker Point, Stevens Canyon, White River, & Sunrise Roads. Closed roads may be open to bicycling when work is not underway on the road. Always check signs on closed road gates before proceeding.

Paradise Road Status: Open, tire chains required, gate closing at 3 p.m.. 10/29/2026: The road is open to Paradise. All vehicles, including 4WD and AWD, must carry tire chains and be ready to use them; today, tire chains are required to be used on all 2-wheel drive vehicles beginning 5 miles beyond Longmire and continuing up to Paradise. The gate will close to uphill travel at 3 p.m. and downhill travel at 4 p.m. to support public safety.

paradise_gate.status: OPEN - Check Alerts for the current daily status of the Longmire gate and other road updates. Regular nightly closures of the gate at Longmire to Paradise begin 10/29/2026 for the winter season. The Paradise Road is assessed each morning before the gate can reopen.
